description: This file defines the AuthActivity class for handling user authentication via Google Sign-In integrated with Firebase Authentication in an Android app. It manages the sign-in flow, processes the credentials, and redirects authenticated users to the MainActivity.

classes.name: AuthActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity that manages Google Sign-In authentication flow using Firebase Auth, handles sign-in intents, and navigates to MainActivity upon success.

methods.name: buildIntentSenderRequest
methods.description: Creates an IntentSenderRequest object from an IntentSender for launching the sign-in activity.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes FirebaseAuth and SignInClient instances, sets up the sign-in button click listener.

methods.name: startAuthFlow
methods.description: Starts the Google Sign-In process by requesting a sign-in intent through the One Tap API.
